steps.title: A sequence
steps.say: Each command runs until it finishes, then the next starts.

board.code:
Commands.sequence(
    new DriveDistanceCommand(5.0),
    new TurnToAngleCommand(45.0),
    new DriveDistanceCommand(2.0),
    ShooterCommands.shoot().withTimeout(2.0))

marks.label: shoot for two seconds, then stop

steps.title: Don't write it eight times
steps.say: A square is the same two steps, four times. A loop adds them.

steps.title: Open Autos.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Autos` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find leftAuto
steps.say: Find the first routine. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `leftAuto` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: Open RobotContainer.java
steps.say: Then let the drive team pick it. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `RobotContainer` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find addOption
steps.say: Find the chooser. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `addOption` and press Enter to jump to it.

target.text: add the autos to the chooser

steps.title: The chooser
steps.say: Add each routine with `autoChooser.addOption("Left Auto", Autos.leftAuto());`.

target.text: add the autos to the chooser

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Pick and run
steps.say: Pick **Left Auto** from the autonomous chooser in the Driver Station, choose **Auto**, and Enable. Watch `Drive/Pose` on AdvantageScope's 2D Field.
